9.6 MW turbine installed at Duqm SEZAD
Adds utility-scale renewable capacity to an industrial hub, supporting decarbonisation.
Indicates broader buildout beyond a single unit; scales impact on power mix.
Sets output expectations that can displace fossil generation at SEZAD.
Duqm South adds five turbines, 48 MW
Most capacity still to come; follow-on execution risk and upside.
Signals localization of supply chain and potential cost/lead-time benefits.

This is an early-stage execution milestone in Oman’s renewables buildout tied to industrial decarbonisation. A larger catalyst would be COD for all 58 MW, firm offtake details, and evidence of stable output under GCC conditions.
